scenario.title: Finding deeper help and knowing who owns it
situations: Human or agent encounters an unfamiliar concept
A command refuses or only gives a short answer
A public reader wants an overview or deeper article
An external project needs its own rules or a Pack guide
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Which documents require split, merge, promotion, retirement or missing coverage?
Can every child identify its parent and every overview lead to all intended children?
Do CLI help, packets, refusals and UI links resolve for ordinary installations as well as source developers?

lessons.title: Summary → category overview → article → precise operation
lessons.when: Proactive pointer, help request or browsing public docs
lessons.need: Give each level a short explanation, scope and links down and back up. A person should be able to find the right concept without knowing the command name first.
lessons.surface: Public overview/index, category summaries and article breadcrumbs
lessons.gap: The cascade is the proposed navigation principle; category boundaries remain open. Current Help’s bare README pointer needs the accepted installed-doc repair.

lessons.title: One public source, several delivery surfaces
lessons.when: Following a source link, updating guidance or diagnosing drift
lessons.need: Product help is authored under docs/public and delivered to the website and installed .yoke/docs. Project rules/docs and installed Pack files have separate ownership.
lessons.surface: Public source → website / install bundle; project-owned documents remain local
lessons.gap: A public and installed copy are distribution, not two authorities. Private Yoke/Platform operations should link to public customer guidance; exact build versions can differ.

lessons.title: Short feedback that tells you where to go next
lessons.when: Every result, especially a setup gap or refusal
lessons.need: Routine output stays short; failures name the reason, missing fact and recovery. Agents can request deeper structured data without losing required context in a quiet-mode change.
lessons.surface: Command feedback, receipts, --help and deeper pointers
lessons.gap: Audit the whole refusal → reachable installed guide → successful recovery chain. Do not mistake a reference page’s existence for a usable journey.
